title: Version Update - Adding WISTD and Water to DBS 96-Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Corning 96 Well Plate 360 µL Flat Slot
Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Select API version and parameters
steps.instruction: Confirm the protocol uses Opentrons API Version 2 (updating from Version 1) and set the customizable parameters for the starting tip column and the number of samples per run.

steps.title: Download protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package, which contains the custom labware definition JSON files for the glass trough (Electron Microscopy Sciences), Omegaquant 96‑Well Plate, Blood Tube Rack, 200 µL Tip Rack, and the reservoir/plate.

steps.title: Upload labware definition
steps.instruction: In the OT App, upload the custom labware definition JSON file(s) for all custom labware.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol script to the OT App, ensuring you are using the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App version 3.19.0 or later.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the map: Slot 2 – Corning 96 Well Plate 360 µL Flat; Slot 4 – Opentrons 96 Tip‑Rack 300 µL; Slot 5 – Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish; Slot 9 – Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish; mount the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette on the left side.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and the P300‑Multi pipette using the OT App calibration workflow (refer to Opentrons support articles for guidance).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the protocol execution.
